disclosures.text: A vacuum gripper is portable or hand-held.
A rigid base element has a first side and a second side.
The second side of the base element has a central area and a periphery.
A loop-shaped vacuum seal element has an attachment surface.
The vacuum seal element is mounted to the periphery of the second side of the base element.
The vacuum seal element has a protruding portion free of contact with the rigid base element.
The protruding portion extends along the entire attachment surface.
The protruding portion extends away from the first side of the base element.
A contact surface is part of the protruding portion.
The contact surface is configured for at least partial contact with an object surface.
The vacuum seal element is elastically deformable at the contact surface.
The elastic deformation enables the contact surface to conform to the object surface.
The vacuum seal element has an inner encircling surface facing the central area.
The vacuum seal element has an outer encircling surface facing away from the inner encircling surface.
Both encircling surfaces extend between the contact and attachment surfaces.
A chamber is defined by the protruding portion and the central area of the base element.
An air extraction means is mounted to the first side of the base element.
The air extraction means is in fluid communication with the chamber through the base element.
The air extraction means continuously extracts air from the chamber.
Air extraction causes the contact surface to grip the object surface.
At least one bracing structure protrudes from the second side of the base element.
The bracing structure protrudes less than the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure is made of a material more rigid than the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure extends along a part of the periphery free of contact with the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure material is less rigid than the base element material.

A portable or hand-held vacuum gripper comprises a rigid base element with a central area and periphery, a loop-shaped vacuum seal element with an attachment surface, protruding portion, and contact surface, defining a chamber, an air extra
The periphery of the second side of the base element is bounded by a peripheral rim.
The periphery comprises a peripheral support area for the vacuum seal element attachment surface.
The peripheral support area constitutes a majority of the periphery.
A majority of the protruding portion is within a lateral boundary defined by the peripheral rim.
The vacuum seal element is mounted via a channel.
The channel receives an attachment portion of the vacuum seal element.
The protruding portion protrudes from the channel along the entire attachment portion.
The channel width corresponds to the thickness of the attachment portion.
The channel depth corresponds to the height of the attachment portion.
The protruding portion protrudes from the channel along its entire width.
The channel width does not exceed the thickness of the protruding portion.
The contact surface is co-extensive with the channel along its entire width.
The peripheral rim constitutes one wall of the channel.
A handle for holding the vacuum gripper is connected to the first side of the base element.
The handle is connected at at least two spaced apart locations.
The handle comprises two handle mounting sections.
The handle mounting sections are integrally connected to the first side of the base element.
A graspable handle section extends between the mounting sections.
The air extraction means comprises a power source.
The power source is mounted at least partially within one handle mounting section.
The air extraction means comprises an air extraction mechanism.
The air extraction mechanism is an impeller or a pump.
The air extraction mechanism is mounted within the handle.
The air extraction mechanism is mounted within one of the handle mounting sections.
Both the power source and the air extraction mechanism are at least partially housed in the two handle mounting portions.
The power source and air extraction mechanism are housed in two different handle mounting portions.
The bracing structure has a loop shape.
